items.title: The number of minimal primes of a filtered colimit of faithfully flat maps is the supremum of the stages
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a directed colimit of rings whose transition maps are faithfully flat, the lemma shows that the number of minimal primes of the colimit, as an element of the natural numbers with infinity, is the supremum of the numbers of minimal primes of the stages. The proof compares the minimal primes of the colimit with those of the stages using the faithful flatness of the transition maps, which lets minimal primes descend and ascend, and then takes the supremum. Descending minimal primes along faithfully flat maps is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10311-10331.
